City Unveils the Marlowe Heritage Museum

The Marlowe Heritage Museum has officially opened its doors to the public. The newly constructed building has been designed with sustainability in mind, featuring roof-mounted solar panels to reduce electricity costs and a rainwater collection system that waters the surrounding gardens.

Freya Osgood, the director, brings a great deal of knowledge to the institution. She is a veteran curator with more than 25 years of experience in museum management. “Our aim is to create a place that is both educational and environmentally responsible,” Ms. Osgood said during the opening ceremony.
